image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a wombat emerging from a dark burrow entrance. The animal has coarse, grey-brown fur and a stocky, barrel-shaped body. Its head is broad with small eyes and rounded ears. The nose appears large and dark. The foreground consists of dirt, dry grass, and twigs. The background is the shadowed interior of the burrow and rocky earth.

The transition between the rock/earth above the wombat and the dark void of the burrow is slightly soft and indistinct, lacking a crisp physical edge, though this could also be attributed to depth-of-field blur.
